style.prompt:

One single film frame, not a grid, storyboard or collage; no text, timecodes or signatures. New shot: A low, wide side view places @car in the left third of the frame on the road through @desert, facing right. @desert fills the foreground and horizon. Late-afternoon sunlight falls from frame left beneath a clear sky; @car casts a long shadow toward frame right.
New in this shot: @car: Sports coupe, 4.6 meters long and 1.9 meters wide, with graphite metallic bodywork, black alloy wheels, tinted windows, and narrow LED headlights.

request: Car ad, 20 seconds, 4 scenes: the car in the desert; inside the car in the desert, its keychain; the same car drifting in Tokyo at night; inside the car in Tokyo, the same keychain.

doc.style: Photoreal cinematic imagery with warm sand and cool neon palettes, fine film grain, crisp surfaces, and sculpted directional light.

assets.label: @car
assets.look: Sports coupe, 4.6 meters long and 1.9 meters wide, with graphite metallic bodywork, black alloy wheels, tinted windows, and narrow LED headlights.

assets.label: @keychain
assets.look: Keychain, 9 centimeters long, consisting of a brushed-steel split ring, a black rectangular key fob, and a small red leather tab.

assets.label: @desert
assets.look: Desert basin, approximately 5 kilometers across, with ocher dunes, distant rock ridges, and a straight asphalt road.

assets.label: @cabin
assets.look: Car cabin inside @car, approximately 2.4 meters long and 1.5 meters wide, with black leather upholstery, brushed-metal dashboard trim, and a dashboard ignition slot.

assets.label: @tokyo
assets.look: Tokyo street intersection, approximately 40 meters across, bordered by multistory commercial buildings, Japanese neon signage, asphalt lanes, and painted crosswalks.

start.description: A low, wide side view places @car in the left third of the frame on the road through @desert, facing right. @desert fills the foreground and horizon. Late-afternoon sunlight falls from frame left beneath a clear sky; @car casts a long shadow toward frame right.

scenes.action: Over five seconds, @car drives steadily from the left third to the right third of the road through @desert.

end.description: The same low, wide side view places @car in the right third of the frame on the road through @desert, facing right. @desert fills the foreground and horizon. Late-afternoon sunlight falls from frame left beneath a clear sky; @car casts a long shadow toward frame right.

changes.label: @car
changes.from: Left third of the frame on the road
changes.to: Right third of the frame on the road

start.description: A tight dashboard-level view frames @cabin around @keychain, which hangs from the ignition near frame center, angled 20 degrees left of vertical. @desert appears softly out of focus through the windshield along the upper edge. Warm late-afternoon light enters from the left; the visible sky is clear.

scenes.action: Over five seconds, @keychain swings gently from its leftmost position to its rightmost position inside @cabin.

end.description: The same tight dashboard-level view frames @cabin around @keychain, which hangs from the ignition near frame center, angled 20 degrees right of vertical. @desert appears softly out of focus through the windshield along the upper edge. Warm late-afternoon light enters from the left; the visible sky is clear.

start.description: A low, wide three-quarter view frames @tokyo with @car at the left edge of the intersection, its nose pointing diagonally toward frame right and its headlights illuminated. It is a dry, clear night. Cyan and magenta light from @tokyo falls across @car and the road.

scenes.action: Over five seconds, @car drifts across @tokyo, sliding toward frame right while rotating its nose toward the camera.

end.description: The same low, wide three-quarter view frames @tokyo with @car in the right half of the intersection, its nose pointing diagonally toward the camera and its headlights illuminated. It is a dry, clear night. Cyan and magenta light from @tokyo falls across @car and the road.

changes.to: Nose pointing diagonally toward the camera
